correctness.rationale: The two independent standalone verifiers check all 1023 input subsets. The unrestricted covering optimum is exhaustively found among all strings of lengths 4 through 13, justified by explicit full-coverage length-13 witness. Greedy recursion branches over every pair, order and orientation attaining maximal overlap, and terminates in one fewer component; induction proves exhaustiveness. Both verifiers agree on every (optimum,worst-greedy) histogram cell and six equality masks. Hand-checkable ratio-4/3 witness is provided.

value.rationale: This is the complete exact approximation and equality classification over the canonical first ten-class binary reverse-complement four-mer universe. The all-subsets ratio and joint optimum/worst-greedy spectrum expose precise orientation/tie effects, separate pairwise greedy from other SCS-RC algorithms, and provide an independently reproducible finite benchmark.
